_comment: Config for bin/verify-macos. Copy to verify-macos.json (gitignored) and run
`bin/verify-macos --record` once from a state you trust to capture baselines.
Each check runs apple-tools with `args`, pulls a number out of the JSON with
the jq expression in `count`, and compares it to `baseline`. Output shapes
differ per tool — most wrap results in `.count`, `documents` uses `.total`,
and `reminders lists` returns a bare array — so `count` is per-check rather
Pick search terms that match YOUR library and are broad enough to stay
stable: a term with one match today can legitimately reach zero tomorrow.
Not covered here, deliberately: screenshot and open_uri (side-effecting),
clipboard (depends on what you last copied), echo (no OS dependency), and
every write path (send, draft, create) — this suite must never mutate
_min_percent_comment: A check is raised when it falls below this percentage of its baseline.
Counts drift on their own — you delete files, people leave your photo
library — and flagging every decrease would make this noise nobody reads.
A store that actually breaks collapses, it does not shrink 5%.
Returning 0 against a positive baseline is always raised, regardless.
Override per check with a `min_percent` field.
